# montecarlo_hive_s3_credentials (Data Source)

Hive (S3) credentials are the S3 location of Hive query logs from EMR, and the IAM role Monte Carlo assumes to read them. A Hive (S3) connection goes on a data-lake warehouse and collects query logs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `assumable_role` (String) ARN of the IAM role in your AWS account that the deployment assumes.
- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket Monte Carlo reads from.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `external_id` (String) External id your role's trust policy requires, if it requires one. It is not the deployment's `aws_external_id`. Null unless set.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `prefix` (String) Key prefix the objects sit under, such as `emr/prod`. Leave out the bucket, a leading `/` and any `s3://` scheme.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
